states.owner_baseline: Weld examination uses qualified personnel, specified NDE standards, ISO 5817 level B acceptance, defect-free expectations and cooldown integrity verification where applicable.
states.owner_disposition: Require weld-class/NDE/acceptance/cryogenic qualification matrix; formal EQ/deviation for any reduction.

states.owner_baseline: Standalone commissioning includes pressure integrity, controls/interlocks, instrument-calibration validation and required control/sequence/rotating-equipment tuning.
states.owner_disposition: No-repeat site calibration may be accepted only with traceable valid certificates, integrity evidence, loop checks and recalibration triggers; all other activities require positive evidence.

states.owner_baseline: WCS SAT covers the specified mechanical, vibration/noise/oil, cooling-water, control/interlock, process and acceptance checks.
states.owner_disposition: Require clause-to-test WCS SAT crosswalk; proposal scope cannot redefine RTM coverage.

states.owner_baseline: QRB SAT covers specified mechanical/vibration, controls, cold-compressor design points/full speed, all relevant devices/modes and acceptance criteria.
states.owner_disposition: Allow Commissioning evidence reuse only with controlled traceability and SAT integrated-mode proof; preserve CC point/full-speed and vibration acceptance coverage.

states.owner_baseline: SAT proves stable operation across each operational scenario and relevant transitions using the specified capacity, margin, flow, stability, load-balance, transient and unstable-mode metrics.
states.owner_disposition: Require scenario x transition x metric acceptance matrix; reduced combinations only by demonstrated Owner-approved equivalence.
